question.text: Underline the changes in the field of society and economy from the Rig Vedic to the later Vedic period

extraction.extractedText:
Underline the changes in field of Society and Economy from Rigvedic to later vedic period.

Vedic Society/Age was divided into Early vedic and later vedic on basis of development in Socio-Economic and cultural spheres.

Early Vedic/Rigvedic Society | Later vedic Society
------------------------------|--------------------
-Varna system started with 3 Varnas | -Chaturvarna System started which is rigid.
-It was egalitarian Society, where Varna is based on profession and one can change it. | -It was highly orthodox Society.
-Women here enjoyed freedom, there were Scholars like gargi lopamudra who wore sacred thread. | -Strict implementa-tion of Varna ashrama Dharmas. -Women lost their freedom, social evils entered like dowry, childmarriage.
-No practice of Antouchability in Rigvedic age. | -Sudras were given varna status and seen as untouchables.

Similar to social aspects, there were differenes in Economicaspects as well.

Rig vedic Economy | Later Vedic Economy.
-------------------|--------------------
-It was Pastoral Economy | -Transition from Pastoral to Agriculture
-Primitive tools used & subsistence Agriculture practiced. | -Use of Iron Started called krishna ayas"
-Cattle were seen as wealth. Cow was sacred called Duhitri | -Sudras became Agriculturists
-cultivation of Rice wheat, Barley is observed | -Rise of trade and commerce
-It was Rural Economy as Rigved-ic mention puram only once. | -Guilds wereformed called Srenis.
-Small trade exists called Panis | -They used painted grey ware. called Neela Lohita

Thus, Rig vedic to Later vedic period a huge transition is observed.
